_comment: What version this copy is. The same file on GitHub is what an update check compares against, so the two are always the same shape. Bump it in the commit that releases, and add the matching section to CHANGELOG.md. Three other places carry this number too -- .claude-plugin/plugin.json, the marketplace entry beside it, and the git tag -- and 'claude plugin tag' checks that they agree.
_headline: One sentence, spoken aloud when an update is found. Write it for the ear.
headline: The square that stopped her is a pause now: it holds her mid-word and carries on from that word, and the play pause key on your keyboard or your headphones works it too.
_notes: The two or three things worth hearing about this release. The full account lives in CHANGELOG.md.
notes: The stop button in the panel is a pause button now. It holds her where she is, mid word if that is where you pressed it, and carries on from that same word rather than starting the line again.

Nothing is lost while it is held. The queue goes on filling and the engine keeps its model, so you can pause to take a call and hear what arrived while you were gone. If you would rather not, the skip all button beside it empties the queue.
The play pause key on your keyboard or your headphones works it as well, but only while she has something to say. The rest of the time the key is left to whatever you were listening to.
_needsSetup: true when a release changes the slash command, the hooks or the notes -- the parts a pull alone does not reinstall.
